This does the trick! I've noticed it doesn't layer over certain serums as well as I had hoped, causing a bit of pilling, but to be honest, this product works well enough that I don't really need to put any serums before it at all anyways. I am able to layer facial lotions over it without any issue though for added moisture which is wonderful. My only true complaint with this product is that it doesn't come in a bigger bottle, since I expect I'll be going through this product very fast.
